label: Not Interested
script: I completely understand, and I wouldn't expect you to be interested until you knew what we could actually do for you. Most homeowners I work with felt the same way initially. Would it be fair if I just shared one quick insight about what's happening with home values in your neighborhood? If it's not relevant, I'll never call again.

label: Not Interested (Firm)
script: I hear you, and I respect that completely. Before I let you go — I'm not trying to sell you anything today. I'm just the neighborhood specialist, and I put together a free home value report for your area. Can I email that over? No strings attached. If your plans change in the future, you'll have my number.

label: Already Has Agent
script: That's great that you have someone you trust. I'm not looking to step on any toes. Quick question though — are you locked into an exclusive agreement with them, or are you still exploring your options? Sometimes a second opinion on pricing can actually help you and your current agent get a better result.

label: Bad Timing
script: I totally understand, I caught you at a busy moment. I'll be brief — just 30 seconds. I'm reaching out because homes in your area are selling for [X]% above what most owners expect. When would be the best time for a quick 5-minute chat? I'm available mornings or evenings — what works better for you?

label: Not Selling
script: That's totally fine — most of the people I talk to aren't actively selling. The reason I'm calling is that your home has likely appreciated significantly. Would you be open to knowing what it's worth in today's market? No commitment at all. A lot of homeowners are surprised by the number and it helps with financial planning, refinancing, even insurance.

label: Just Bought / Just Signed
script: Congratulations on the new home! I know selling is the last thing on your mind right now. I actually call new homeowners to introduce myself as the neighborhood specialist. I track values in your area closely — would it be helpful if I sent you a quick annual update on your home's equity? It's great for tracking your investment, and if your plans change down the road, you'll already have a trusted contact.

label: Price Concern
script: I hear that concern a lot, and honestly it's smart to be thinking about timing. Here's what the data actually shows for your specific neighborhood — values have [increased/held steady] over the past 12 months. What if I put together a no-obligation market analysis for your home specifically? That way you're making decisions based on real numbers, not headlines. Would that be helpful?

label: Do Not Call
patterns: how did you get my number
on the do not call list
script: I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. I'll remove your number from our list right away. You won't receive any more calls from us. I hope you have a great rest of your day.
